description:
Register a VERIFIED restoration project so retirements against its
    credits can be funded. verification_ref (D-Score / land-verification /
    registry id) is required — only verified conservation is funded.
    project_id is immutable once registered.

methodology.description: Optional. The methodology code, for example VM0047.
methodology.title: Methodology

verification_ref.description: Required. The verification attestation or registry id.
verification_ref.title: Verification Ref

name: register_project
title: Register project
